Subtitle: Your voice. Your space.
CalibrationHelp: Speak normally with a few pauses for 8 seconds. No recording is retained.
CalibrationNoise: Voice is too quiet or too close to background noise. Move closer and try again.
CalibrationClip: Input is clipping. Lower the Windows microphone level and try again.
CalibrationInsufficient: Not enough signal. Check the microphone and try again.
CaptureInfo: Microphone active. Audio follows the outputs selected in Mic Setup.
NoInput: No microphone available. Connect one, then refresh.
SoundInfo: MP3/WAV import, folders and playback with independent routing are planned for phase 5.
LabInfo: Models and local voice conversion will arrive in phases 8–11. No AI engine is loaded.
HotkeyHelp: Click, then press a combination with Ctrl, Alt or Shift. Escape cancels.
Conflict: Shortcut unavailable or already assigned. Previous binding remains active.
Scope: Local studio · audio, soundboard and voice conversion
Error: Something went wrong. Check the logs for details.
Recovered: Configuration recovered after a read error.
Disconnected: Microphone stopped or disconnected. Select a device and restart.
Privacy: No cloud. No telemetry. No automatic recording.
DeviceHint: Choose your physical microphone, then start capture.
OutputUnavailable: Virtual output is unavailable in this phase: Discord does not receive MyVoice yet.
GainNote: Digital gain is applied to captured audio before peak protection.
ChooseOutput: Choose headphones or a virtual output in Mic Setup.
DeleteFolderConfirm: Delete this folder? Its sounds will move to another folder.
DeleteSoundConfirm: Remove this sound from the library?
VirtualHelp: Headphones: select your physical output. Virtual output: select CABLE Input (playback). In Discord, choose CABLE Output as your microphone. Both destinations are independent.
HeadphoneHint: Choose headphones in Mic Setup, then enable Hear my voice.
DropAudio: Drop audio files here. They are copied into your library.
SoundboardHint: Select a card for details. Only the ▶ button plays audio.
ReferenceTooShort: At least one second of audible speech is required. Import a clear recording with little background noise.
VoiceCreated: Voice reference created. Start the engine to test it.
DeleteVoiceConfirm: Remove this voice from your library?
AiSelectFirst: Start the engine and select a reference voice.
AiLiveRequirements: Select a voice and wait for the engine. Microphone connects automatically.
LabIntro: Create a voice identity from your recordings. Local conversion, without a subscription or speech transcription.
OfflineHelp: Test a voice on an audio file and save the result as WAV.
LiveHelp: Converted audio follows your headphone / virtual microphone routing. Latency depends on the profile.
VoiceConsent: Only use recordings you own or have permission to use.
LimiterNote: Peak protection is active on both outputs.
NoUpdateSource: Automatic updates are not enabled for this release yet.
UpdateCurrent: You are using the latest published version.
AiCpuOffline: CPU mode supports file conversion. Live AI requires CUDA: choose auto and restart the engine.
AiInstallHint: Initial download of several GB from the official projects. Subsequent conversions stay local.
VirtualTestPlaying: Test tone sent to virtual output (1 s).
DatasetIntro: Prepare voices from multiple recordings. Originals and previous versions are preserved.
SampleTips: Use one speaker, varied clean speech, no music or strong reverb. Level analysis does not classify music or speakers.
ReferenceLimit: Your full dataset is retained. Studio pools speaker identity from up to 64 reference segments, with at most 25 seconds per reference. This does not train a personal model.
SimilarityTip: Lower keeps more original timbre. Higher guides the model toward the target and may increase artifacts. Recommended: 70%. Separate from speed.
PerformanceTip: Expressive: fixed 20 / 30 / 40 steps. Conversation: initial 4 / 6 / 8 steps, measured window at voice load; adaptation only in pauses. Direct: 6 / 12 / 24 steps.
ComputeTip: Auto uses CUDA if available, otherwise CPU. Microphone source remains available. CPU may be too slow for live use. DirectML is unsupported.
DynamicsTip: Follows relative volume and pauses in Keep my intonation mode and in the classic engine. Reference expression keeps the generated rhythm.
CpuRealtimeWarning: Processing cannot keep up: normal voice restored to avoid growing delay. Try Low latency or CUDA.
QuickVoiceTip: Switch between clean and the last selected voice.
LastSound: Open the last sound controls without replaying it.
BassTip: Lower: less rumble. Higher: warmer, potentially muddy. Recommended: 0 dB.
MidTip: Controls presence and nasal character. Recommended: 0 dB.
TrebleTip: Lower: softer. Higher: brighter, more hiss. Recommended: 0 dB.
GateTip: Lower threshold preserves quiet sounds. Higher removes more noise but may cut speech. Recommended: −48 dB.
CompressorTip: Reduces quiet/loud differences. More compression is steadier but less natural. Recommended: 3:1.
CpuMayBeSlow: CPU selected: measuring performance. Normal voice takes over if processing is too slow.
SoundClickHelp: Click to play. Right-click to preview, organize or edit.
